subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 grouped executable-action updates be accepted together after exact-head checks pass, or should token, Codex-agent, release, and security-scanning actions receive separate review PRs?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but it changes third-party code executing with credentials and security permissions; repository intent is needed to accept the grouped review boundary.

options.title: Approve grouped pins after green checks
options.body: Keep the grouped immutable-pin update and merge only after a security/workflow owner reviews upstream changes and the exact head is fully green.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate token, Codex-agent, release, and CodeQL updates so each security-sensitive execution boundary can be reviewed and rolled back independently.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped pins after green checks
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped immutable-pin update and merge only after a security/workflow owner reviews upstream changes and the exact head is fully green.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workflow history, CODEOWNERS routing, and direct timeline engagement make this the strongest available decision owner.
